title: EVM Chain Catalog and Capabilities (V2.8)
description: Reference schema for config/chains.json. Defines the canonical EVM chains catalog, chain metadata, aliases, and hardware/compiler capabilities without coupling detectors to network names (docs/decisiones.md D-058).

catalogVersion.description: Version of the chains catalog schema/data.

chains.description: List of recognized EVM chain definitions. chainId must be unique.

chainId.description: Canonical EIP-155 integer chain ID. Primary identity.

aliases.description: Alternative names/aliases resolving to this chainId.

type.description: Architecture category of the EVM chain.

evmVersion.description: Default or active EVM specification target (e.g. cancun, shanghai, paris).

capabilities.description: Feature and opcode availability flags for this chain.

supportsPush0.description: True if PUSH0 opcode (Shanghai+) is natively supported.

supportsTransientStorage.description: True if TSTORE/TLOAD opcodes (Cancun+) are supported.

supportsCancun.description: True if full Cancun EVM specification is active.

businessRules: R-K1: chainId (numeric integer) is the single canonical identity of an EVM network.
R-K2: Detectors must check capabilities flags (e.g. supportsPush0), never branch on network name strings.
R-K3: Unknown chains (not in catalog) are represented with isKnown=False and empty capabilities without guessing.
R-K4: Same contract address on different chainIds must never collide or cross-contaminate systemGraph or analysis.
